rule: First six originals in order. Every A/B source/completion/correctness gate and exact joins must pass, states must agree. Both B latency gates must pass: p99<=25ms,p999<=100ms,every-minute-p99<=25ms. Baseline A latency failures remain reported but do not block selection. EACH pair B/A p99<=0.90,p999<=1.00. Only then run sustained-b1 1800s in same configuration. No default promotion.
